title: Sohar Health Launches ‘Discovery’ to Revolutionize Patient Intake
summary: Yahoo Finance has covered the launch of Sohar Health’s new AI-driven Discovery feature, enabling instant insurance discovery during patient intake—streamlining workflows and helping providers boost conversion rates.
body_markdown:
Sohar Health’s *Discovery* product, now live, significantly simplifies patient intake: by entering just four details, providers receive coverage verification and eligibility checks within seconds—enhancing experience and speeding up scheduling.


You can read the full[article](https://finance.yahoo.com/news/sohar-health-launches-discovery-transforming-130000354.html) here.
